text:
emily_support: FYI — AcmeMaps escalated: billing alerts fired for a massive token spike in the console. Customer screenshot shows a 00:00–00:05 5m bucket with +1200% usage vs prior window, and the chart drops to nearly zero for the 23:45–00:00 buckets. Ticket #2321. @raj_infra can you triage?

raj_infra: on it. Can you paste the raw query/screenshot and the alert rule (threshold + window)?

emily_support: Alert rule is `tokens_sum > 100000 over 5m` (per-project). I ran a quick aggregation in Console query: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM token_usage WHERE project_id='acmemaps' GROUP BY time(5m)` — result returns a weird bucket at 00:05 with 1.2M tokens, then several earlier 5m buckets are near 0. Screenshot attached in ticket (customer also included export).

taylor_sre: saw similar noise for two other customers around 23:58–00:10 UTC last night. My hunch: rollup/aggregation service started shifting bucket boundaries. We had a rollout for rollup-service around that time.

ingest-bot: deploy/rollup-service v2.14.0 deployed at 1769999000 by jess_prod (canary -> prod).

jess_prod: yep that deploy had an attempted fix for batching latency. I unintentionally set `AGG_OFFSET_SECONDS=60` in the k8s env when testing local rollups to align minute boundaries — I forgot to revert. Sorry everyone.

raj_infra: that would do it — adding 60s offset will move events into adjacent 5m buckets. Immediate mitigation: set env back to `AGG_OFFSET_SECONDS=0` and restart the deployment, then backfill/rehydrate affected rollups for the last 3 hours. Also suppress the alert for `acmemaps` while we backfill.

ops-charlie: temporary alert suppression command we use: `POST /api/v1/alerts/suppress {"alert_id":"tokens_sum_acmemaps","duration_min":60}` — will mute while backfill runs.

taylor_sre: repro steps I ran locally to confirm: 1) ingest a handful of events with timestamps 23:58:30->00:06:30 2) run rollup with `--window-size=5m --offset=60` 3) query grouped buckets and observe shift. Example run:```python
# simulate
events = [ts for ts in range(1700008710,1700008790,10)]
# rollup aligns to epoch + offset
```Logs show: `INFO rollup: bucket_align shift=60s -> placing 23:55..00:00 events into 00:00..00:05 bucket`. Also saw a couple NTP minor drifts but not material.

raj_infra: plan: 1) revert env and restart (5–10m) 2) run backfill job for 3 hours to recompute aggregated buckets for all affected projects (runbook step in /runbooks/rollup-backfill) 3) verify dashboard vs raw events for a sample set 4) close ticket once backfill completes and customer confirms. I'll own execution.

emily_support: thanks — I'll message AcmeMaps: quick summary + ETA ~2h for backfill and temporary mute. Will keep them updated. :thumbsup:

jess_prod: I'll open a patch PR to make `AGG_OFFSET_SECONDS` explicit in k8s manifests with review guard and add a deploy-time check to prevent non-zero offsets in prod; and add a changelog entry.

taylor_sre: also adding a monitoring check: alert if rollup bucket distribution changes >50% vs previous hour (to detect future shifts).

ops-charlie: follow-ups: create a short postmortem once done, add a test to CI that simulates offset env to ensure we catch config drift.

emily_support: marking ticket pending-engineering and adding link to this thread. Will update last message_ts when backfill finishes. :white_check_mark:
